signature: An endless warm beach stuck at sunset: luxury hotels and glass villas along a lamp-lit promenade, a pool terrace over the lukewarm sea, the Veroka Farmers' grey fruit, and 200 m inland a humid tropical forest whose trenches, lake and farmhouses lead elsewhere

exits.label: Leaned into the lobby wall of a beach hotel until it gave way into another hotel lobby
exits.method: Noclip inside a hotel to the lobby
exits.source_quote: No-clipping inside of a hotel on Level 48 will lead to the lobby of Level 581
exits.hint: The guest book in the lobby mentions a wall that someone leaned on for too long.

exits.label: Played dead on the beach; something dark dragged you away (rumoured, small chance)
exits.method: Play dead on beach floor; The Shadow drags
exits.conditions: 8% chance per attempt; never in QA mode
exits.hint: Someone left a towel on the sand.

exits.label: Walked into a farmhouse in the forest and back out of it
exits.method: Enter and exit a random farmhouse
exits.source_quote: Entering and exiting any of the farmhouses will take you to Level 10.
exits.hint: An old farmhouse stands among the trees west of the trench.

exits.label: Dived to the floor of the small forest lake
exits.method: Swim to floor of a small lake
exits.source_quote: Swimming to the floor of a small lake will transport one back to Level 121
exits.hint: A small lake lies in the forest north-east of the farm.

exits.label: Followed a dirt trench through the forest until it led somewhere else
exits.method: Follow dirt trenches in the forest
exits.source_quote: will progressively lead one to Level 49
exits.conditions: at least 200 m walked inside the trench
exits.hint: A trench starts at the forest edge north of the promenade path.

entity_policy: NO HOSTILE ENTITIES. Forest fauna resembling the Frontrooms is non-hostile and not modelled (heard as insects only); the unique species (Languars, Veraffes, Pinkthers, Zapes, Qarrots) live ~30 km north and are not placed. The Shadow is RUMORED: never shown, only implied by the play-dead caption on a successful roll.
notes: SOURCE: infinite sandy beachfront with a presumably infinite lukewarm ocean to the south; tropical forest 200 m north of the beach; permanent sunny sunset, red-yellow sun at 30% of noon light; 22-36 C by location; many modern luxury houses and hotels with contemporary furniture, appliances and air conditioning; lush vegetation and edible plants; forest of palms, conifers, broadleaf evergreen and deciduous trees; Gromeliads; grey Veroka flowers with grey egg-like fruit rich in vitamin C and potassium, juice with lithium; the Veroka Farmers (~300) with shops selling juice and fruit; M.E.G. rates it Habitable; exits by hotel noclip (581), small-lake floor (121), play dead (100, unconfirmed), following forest dirt trenches (49), entering and exiting a farmhouse (10). EXITS ADDED in this rebuild (all documented edges in data/canon/transitions.json): L048>L581#1, L048>L121#2, L048>L100#3. ADAPTATION: a ~480 x 500 m playable window of the endless beach (soft limit past |x| 232 m or 432 m inland: the sand slows you and the haze thickens; never in QA), with the beach, sea and a canopy band continuing in a far mesh to the horizon; the hotel names, villa designs, pool, terrace, promenade lamps, kiosk and farm shed are our dressing of 'luxury houses and hotels' and 'shops'; the noclip is a sustained 2.2 s push into the lobby's east wall; the lake exit fires at its floor (~4 m down); the trench exit only opens after 200 m walked inside the 290 m trench; the farmhouse exit fires when you leave through its door after being inside; 'randomly seen' farmhouses are represented by one fixed farmhouse; play dead has an 8% chance per attempt. Forest exits are created only within ~90 m so the QA navigation window stays local. Temperature is told through zone captions. Terrain uses CC0 Poly Haven coast_sand_01, sparse_grass, dirt_floor and old_wood_floor textures already in assets/external.
